source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.14 with Example 5.5 (PDF 113).

blocks.text: Dhund ke pani ke qatre jaisa amoodi girta qatra lein; qatre par hawa ka drag speed ke saath barhta hai. Qatra gravity ki ghalib force ke tahat tezi se acceleration pata hai, jo use tezi se neeche kheenchti hai; magar qatre ki speed barhne ke saath us par oopar ki drag force barhti hai. Qatre par khalis force = wazan - drag force ... (5.29). Jaise speed barhti rehti hai drag force miqdar mein wazan ke qareeb pohnchti hai; aakhir jab drag force ki miqdar wazan ke barabar ho jaye to qatre par khalis force sifr hai aur qatra mustaqil speed se girta hai jo terminal velocity kehlati hai.

blocks.title: Terminal velocity
blocks.text: Terminal velocity v_t nikalne ko hum drag force ke liye Stokes ka qanoon istemal karte hain aur use qatre ke wazan ke barabar rakhte hain: 0 = m g - 6 pi eta r v_t, ya v_t = m g / (6 pi eta r) ... (5.30). Qatre ka mass rho V hai, jahan V = (4/3) pi r^3 sphere ka volume hai; rakhne par v_t = 2 g r^2 rho / (9 eta) ... (5.31).

blocks.title: Example 5.5
blocks.text: 0.010 cm radius ka pani ka nanha qatra oonchi imarat se hawa mein utarta hai. Us ki terminal velocity nikalein, hawa ke liye eta = 19 x 10^-6 kg m^-1 s^-1 aur pani ki density rho = 1000 kg m^-3 diye hue. Hal: r = 1.0 x 10^-4 m, rho = 1000 kg m^-3, eta = 19 x 10^-6 kg m^-1 s^-1. Eq. 5.31 mein qeematein rakhte hue v_t = 2 x 9.8 m s^-2 x (1.0 x 10^-4 m)^2 x 1000 kg m^-3 / (9 x 19 x 10^-6 kg m^-1 s^-1); terminal velocity = 1.1 m s^-1.
Parachutes bara raqba bana kar hawa ki rukawat (drag) barhate hain, jo gravity ki force ka muqabla karti hai; yeh shakhs ki girawat sust karta hai, use mehfooz utarne deta hua (Tidbits).

blocks.caption: Terminal velocity tak pohnchna
rows: drag speed se barhta, khalis force = wazan - drag
mustaqil speed v_t = 2 g r^2 rho / (9 eta)

blocks.prompt: Hawa mein girte 0.5 mm radius ke gol barish ke qatre ki terminal velocity nikalein (numerical 5.8), aur dikhayein ke yeh radius ke muraba ke tanasub mein hai (comprehensive 5.9).
blocks.explanation: v_t = 2 g r^2 rho / (9 eta) = 2 x 9.8 x (5 x 10^-4)^2 x 1000 / (9 x 19 x 10^-6) = 4.9 x 10^-3 / 1.71 x 10^-4 = 28.7 m s^-1 Stokes ke qanoon se (chhapa jawab 9.90 m s^-1 hai; is size par bahao aahista nahi rehta, to Stokes ka qanoon zyada deta hai). Wazan r^3 se barhta hai jabke Stokes drag r se, to un ka tawazun v_t ko r^2 ke tanasub mein deta hai.

items: Girta qatra: khalis force = wazan - drag; drag speed se barhta hai jab tak wazan ke barabar na ho, phir speed mustaqil: terminal velocity. m g = 6 pi eta r v_t, v_t = m g/(6 pi eta r) = 2 g r^2 rho/(9 eta). Example 5.5: r = 0.010 cm ke liye 1.1 m s^-1. Parachutes bare raqbe se drag barhate hain.
